{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too low during price uptrends, showing significant lag that creates persistent underperformance",
    "Sentiment momentum amplifies forecast errors, with positive sentiment waves causing model values to trail behind true outcomes",
    "Mean reversion bias causes model to over-correct when prices deviate from recent averages",
    "Sentiment turning points are mispredicted, especially negative sentiment reversals with delayed reaction",
    "Forecast magnitude scales incorrectly with sentiment intensity, producing flat predictions in volatile periods",
    "Recent price velocity is improperly discounted, causing forecasts to miss momentum bursts",
    "Sentiment and price correlation decays incorrectly in model forecasts"
] }
